item.title: Grouping zeros: OpenType ligature substitutions right to left
item.description:
Is it possible to do ligature substitutions right to left in OpenType?

I’m working on a special monospaced typeface with ligatures, you can check it out here.

I’m trying to separate zeros in groups of three with a ligature. Examples: 1000000 -> 1 000 000, and 10000 -> 10 000. The substitution should be done right to left, or otherwise the 10000 becomes 1 000 0, as with the following code:
feature liga { sub zero zero zero by zero_zero_zero; }
